name: Nanxing Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanxing Machinery Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, sale, and service of woodworking machinery in China and internationally. The company offers single- and double-sided edge banders; panel dividing saws and CNC nesting machines; CNC drilling and through-feed drilling machines; packing machines; feeder and stackers, turner equipment, and conveyor tables; and nesting and drilling workstations, and edge banding lines. It also provides onsite professional, 24h online quick response, spare parts supplying, and comprehensive training services; and panel furniture, industrial 4,0, software integration, and mass production solutions.…
